page.layout: One printed page, numbered list running down the text block. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right. Cut-off fragments at the far left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: 1. Ab opere molito & initialiter præstitio : scilicet opere redemptionis, regenerationis & amplissimæ instructionis populi. verf. 6. b.
2. A sententia primi Patris & Seniorum, Dominum Israelis eundem cum Angelo ducè agnoscentium: ubi notanda
a. Provocatio ad horum sententiam, 'cum ablegatione immorigerorum ad eam legitime expendendam. verf. 7.
b. Professio fidei ipsa per modum responsi patrum hic inserta, exponens
2. De populo eligendo, seu à gentibus separando. verf. 8. 9.
3. De ducendo hoc populo, & fovendo in deserto. verf. 10 . 12.
4. De eodem in terrâ hæreditatis confirmando & benedicendo. verf 13.
II. Effectum consequens, ut ex benevolentia redundans in feram illam posteritatem, quam actor in hoc actu compellat. verf. 14.
III. Actus tertius, quo actor horum σκληροκαρδίαν perspiciens, eorundem sceleus cum indignatione adumbrat, tanquam ἀναπολόγητον, ex eo
A. Quod vestigia patrum carnalium, non obstantibus objurgationibus propheticis in malo pergentium, secuti fuerint, sceleusque absolverint. verf. 15.
1. Convertendo se, tanquam ad novum idolum. Quod valdè exaggerat. verf. 16. 17.
2. A vertendo se à rupe salutis, cum turpi benefactoris oblivione. verf. 18.

page.notes: Left edge: cut-off fragments of the neighbouring page's text (e.g. "as Ju-", "ationi", "proce-", "argu-", "ebat,") are excluded as the edge of the adjacent page. Doubtful readings: the numerals before "2. De populo" (a blot over it), "3. De ducendo" and "4. De eodem" (the numerals look irregular in the scan), and "II." before "Effectum" (printed as ıı.). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "Professio", "Israelis"). Greek is copied from the scan; the letters of σκληροκαρδίαν and ἀναπολόγητον are only moderately clear.
